name: wayshot
summary: Native, fast screenshot tool for wlroots-style Wayland compositors with region select and clipboard copy
description: wayshot captures the screen on Wayland compositors that implement the wlr-screencopy protocol, including Hyprland. It can grab the whole display, one output, or a region picked interactively or passed as a slurp-style geometry string, copy the result to the clipboard, pick a colour from the screen, and write PNG, JPEG, WebP or JPEG XL. Written in Rust by the waycrate project.
